title: Socket isolation boundary
summary: QUIC is selected and acquired below the shared socket abstraction. Applications receive socket/address objects and must not grow QuicDebugTransport, QuicRpcTransport or other protocol-specific parallel network stacks.
invariants: QuicSocketAddress is carried as an object; do not flatten it into host:port text or a generic dictionary.
Debug Socket Transport, RPC and other consumers use the common stream/socket seam unless they intentionally request a selected QUIC child stream.
Connection IDs, UDP mechanics, handshake state, retransmission, packet protection and QUIC timers remain provider-owned.
